beats.say: This chip has been blinking lights since the early seventies, and it's still everywhere.
The five five five timer is an eight pin chip that makes pulses, delays and oscillations.
Add two resistors and a capacitor, and it flashes an LED at a speed you choose.
Next time: the crystal. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

youtube.learn: What the 555 timer does, its 8 pins, and how two resistors and a capacitor set how fast it flashes.
